body:
The maintainer's macOS guest (OSX-KVM on an Intel host) runs the iOS simulator as x86_64, which
neither iosArm64 nor iosSimulatorArm64 serves. Add the iosX64 target to :core and :shared (Room's
KSP processor registered for it too, or AppDbConstructor has no actual), and publish :shared as a
static framework ("Shared") on every iOS target, which the iOS shell (T-353) links. The Linux gate
keeps compiling the two existing targets only; iosX64 is checked on the Mac. Document in
android/core/README.md and android/README.md.
title: iOS: iosX64 target for the Intel simulator and the Shared framework
